_schema_note: v2.11 = v2.10 key set MINUS the 7 degenerate presence binaries (dropped per adversarial RUN_02 Finding D). Presence is read off the paired *_strength field (0=absent). int_*/decoupling are evidence streams for eth_integrity (see v2.11 inject Part B).

_schema_info.purpose: All coders (claude, gpt, pxy) MUST emit this exact key set so inter-coder reliability can be computed mechanically on the 'codes' block. Do not add, rename, or omit keys. Leave value types as specified. Populate every field; never leave a shared-core code blank.
_schema_info.reliability_layer: Inter-coder reliability (kappa/alpha) is computed ONLY on the integer fields in 'codes'. valence_* are proportions (0.00-1.00) and are handled separately. The 'narrative' and 'meta' blocks are for human/adversarial validation, not numeric reliability.
_schema_info.missing_value_convention: 0 = applicable but absent/unsupported; 8 = applicable but unclear/insufficient evidence; 9 = definitionally not applicable. Every *_code field contains exactly one integer and nothing else.
_schema_info.v2.8_scoring_authority: All bare 0-5 fields are now anchored by the v2.8 SCORING ANCHORS block (Part A 0-5 ladder + tie-breaker + CAP; Part B presence triggers for integrity/autonomy/nonmaleficence/justice; Part C int_* scopes; Part D evidence-label tree), injected into every coder paste and embedded in the operational profile. The anchors define the SCALE; this schema defines the KEY SET. Where a bare '0-5 ordinal anchors' line in any embedded crosswalk conflicts, the v2.8 anchors govern.
_schema_info.v2.8_field_set_changes: v2.8 changes the field SET in two sanctioned places only (the documented exception to the keys-must-not-change guard). (A) §3C int_institutional DROPPED: int_institutional_presence_code + int_institutional_intensity_code REMOVED; org-level stated-values-vs-practice is captured by decoupling_signal_code. Canonical SEVEN integrity sub-dimensions -> SIX (academic, research, assessment, system_tevv, data_prov, epistemic). int_assessment re-scoped to 'a form of assessment no longer productive/definitive' (instrument validity, not learner honesty). (B) §3E cost/benefit indicators 24 -> 19: CUT cb_benefit_institutional_performance_code, cb_cost_legitimacy_trust_code, cb_cost_labor_time_code (degenerate constants, fire on ~90-100% of docs, alpha~0); MERGE cb_cost_cognitive_pedagogical_code -> cb_cost_cognitive_psychological_code (renamed from cb_cost_psychological_social_code, now absorbs cognitive/learning harm); MERGE cb_benefit_integrity_detection_code -> cb_benefit_quality_accuracy_code (now also covers AI-assisted integrity/cheating detection); cb_cost_financial_code now also covers labor/time cost; TIGHTEN cb_cost_rights_remedy_gap_code (present ONLY when a SPECIFIC rights/remedy/due-process gap is named). All OTHER keys hold.
_schema_info.v2.8_leave_alone_fields: Do NOT re-anchor these reliable v2.7 fields: eth_privacy_code, dppra_p1_strength_code, eth_equity_code, cb_primary_value_capturer_code, dppra_alignment_score_code, cb_benefit_consistency_standardization_code, journal_method_type_code.
_schema_info.RESOLVED_v2.6_crosswalk_lock: The previously open crosswalks (decoupling_signal_code, market_capture_signal_code, dominant_value_type_code, responsibility_concentration_code, cb_*_evidence_label_code, the cb actor crosswalk, cb_balance_code, cb_distribution_direction_code, and all gov_*_code mappings) are integer-locked in the v2.8 crosswalk lock (carried from DPPRA_v2.6_INTEGER_CROSSWALK_LOCK.md, approved 2026-05-25). All coders MUST use those integers.
_schema_info.RESOLVED_2026-05-27_JRN_domain_lock: The six journal_*_code fields are integer-locked in DPPRA_JRN_INTEGER_CROSSWALK_LOCK_v2.7.md (approved 2026-05-27). JRN coders code them per that lock; GOV/FRM/INS code them 9 (definitionally N/A), exactly as journal coders code the gov_* fields 9.
_schema_info.RESOLVED_2026-05-27_FRM_domain_lock: The eight forum domain fields (learner_posture, assessment_object, external_link_boundary, detection_verification presence+strength, surveillance_monitoring presence+strength, overall_dominant_valence) are integer-locked in DPPRA_FRM_INTEGER_CROSSWALK_LOCK_v2.7.md (approved 2026-05-27). FRM coders code them per that lock; non-forum layers code 9 (assessment_object: 99). NOTE assessment_object_code uses 88=unclear/99=N/A (8 and 9 are real categories). INS domain-specific fields remain to be locked at that layer's first run.
